title: An ideal-power torsion module has a presentation by cyclic ideal-power quotients
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $I\subseteq R$ an ideal and $Q$ an $R$-module such that every $q\in Q$ is annihilated by $I^n$ for some $n\ge1$. There are a set $J$, positive integers $n_j$ for $j\in J$, an $R$-module $P=\bigoplus_{j\in J}R/I^{n_j}$ [def-weil-pbc-direct-sum-modules], and a surjective $R$-linear map $p:P\to Q$. Its kernel $K$ is itself $I$-power torsion. Consequently $0\to K\to P\xrightarrow{p}Q\to0$ is exact [def-weil-pbc-exact-sequence].
